name: mnemonic-webapp
//: Requires wasm-pack on PATH for `build:wasm` (cargo install wasm-pack). Not an npm dependency.

scripts.build: npm run roadmap && npm run build:wasm && tsc -b && vite build

//optionalDependencies: Platform-specific native bindings for @tailwindcss/oxide and lightningcss. npm has a long-standing bug (https://github.com/npm/cli/issues/4828) where optional native subpackages of transitive deps are not installed cross-platform — a package-lock generated on macOS arm64 will not install the Linux x64 binding when re-installed on Linux, breaking VPS deploy. Pinning all dev + deploy targets here as direct optionalDependencies forces `npm install` to fetch them on the running platform regardless of which platform produced the lockfile. Versions MUST track the parent package version exactly (npm enforces strict match on optional native subpackages).
